agents.name: Architect Agent
responsibilities: Review ERP architecture and multi-tier separation
Maintain technical decisions and architectural decision records (ADRs)
Review database schemas, DDL migrations, and domain module boundaries

agents.name: QA Agent
responsibilities: Run linting (bun run lint)
Run integration and unit test suites (bun run test)
Run multi-platform builds (bun run build:all)
Analyze failures and generate regression reports

agents.name: Backend Agent
responsibilities: Maintain Drizzle ORM schemas and query engines
Maintain PostgreSQL connection pools and self-healing migrations
Maintain REST API services and ERP business logic repositories

agents.name: Frontend Agent
responsibilities: Maintain React 18 / Tailwind CSS client user interface
Improve visual consistency and accessibility across ERP modules
Refactor duplicated UI components and maintain zero business logic in components

agents.name: Mobile Agent
responsibilities: Maintain Capacitor Android wrapper and native configs
Maintain Gradle wrapper and native Android build dependencies
Verify Android APK release builds (assembleRelease)

agents.name: Desktop Agent
responsibilities: Maintain Electron main process (electron/main.js) and preload bridge
Configure electron-builder settings for cross-platform installers
Verify Windows EXE installer compilation and release outputs

agents.name: DevOps Agent
responsibilities: Maintain GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/build.yml)
Monitor CI/CD pipeline execution and artifact publishing
Manage versioning, release artifacts, and build deployment automation

agents.name: Security Agent
responsibilities: Review authentication flows and session token handling
Review RBAC role permissions and endpoint authorization gates
Audit secrets management, environment configurations, and dependency vulnerability alerts
